caption: The image shows a rectangular stone relief with three human figures carved in low relief. The object appears to be a gray stone slab with a slightly rough texture and a broken upper right corner. On the left side, there is a figure wearing what appears to be a helmet and a decorated short tunic, holding a weapon raised above their head. In the center, there is a smaller, unclothed figure facing the armed figure, with one arm extended toward the attacker and the other arm raised defensively. On the right side stands a third figure, also helmeted and clothed, holding a large, oval-shaped shield at their side. The upper portion includes carved foliage motifs with curling leaves and stems on each side. Along the bottom of the relief, there is a horizontal strip containing a raised inscription in capital letters. The overall color of the relief is uniform gray.
title: Stove Plate
